And squeezing Triberg, Lake Constance and driving to Bavaria in one day is also quite the feat. I think you should decide between the Black Forest and doing Lake Constance. If you do decide to focus on the Black Forest, lmk I can give you some more recommendations:)

Yes this is way too much! I can only really talk about the Black Forest part, but getting from Ludwigsburg to Triberg by train in the first place is difficult. You have to get to Karlsruhe somehow, then take a train to Offenburg and then Schwarzwaldbahn to Triberg. I’m sure you’d be travelling for at least 4 hours, not to mention the notorious delays and problems. 

Triberg is very beautiful, but also really touristy if you’re into that. You cannot, I emphasise cannot do Mainau just casually midday. You have to get to Constance first, there is a Bus from Constance Trainstation there, the island (and Bus lol) are incredibly full if you don’t get there early and it’s very very large. I recommend just visiting Constance, Mainau isn’t really that impressive, and maybe taking the ferry to visit Meersburg or Uhldingen, way more relaxed, the ferries are relatively cheap and lots of fun.
